items.rationale: Section 5.2.6(b) covers inspection to establish the cause and extent of the loss. The €524 gross flat-rate estimate is below the separate €3,000 assessment limit; the €500 deductible applies once to the event, not to each line.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers locating the leaks. The comparable €707 bundled detection charge, less €150 for technician time and €79 for travel billed separately here, supports about €480; lines 2 and 3 together are below the €1,000 limit.
Section 5.2.6(a) expressly covers on-site leak-location technician time. The separately itemised 2.5 hours at €60 gross per hour total €150 and share the €1,000 leak-location limit with line 2.
Section 5.2.6(c) permits one vehicle charge for this contractor's invoice. The €79 gross estimate is below the €83.30 gross cap (€70 net plus 19% VAT).

items.description: Repair of two actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) treats porosity from material ageing as fracture damage for sections proven to leak, and section 9.1.1 does not treat age alone as a breach. Under section 7.1.1(b), estimate €400 gross for the billed flat-rate repair of both joints.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.5 exclude sections not shown to be leaking; replacing the remaining run was preventive work. The amount shown is a conditional trade-price estimate for the full flat-rate line.

Section 7.1.9 limits reinstatement to the pre-loss standard, and section 2.4.3(a) separately excludes replacement of the non-leaking sections. This line bills only the upgrade difference; the amount shown is a conditional estimate.
Section 5.2.6(c) permits one vehicle charge on the plumber's separate invoice because the visit included the insured joint repairs. The €79 gross estimate is below the €83.30 gross cap.
